extension.summary: Clear the caches of supported add-ons from one screen
extension.description: Kodi Universal Cleaner scans your installed add-ons, shows the ones it supports, and clears their caches using each add-on's own official cleaning command. Only add-ons you tick are touched. It never deletes settings, logins, databases or watched status, and it never guesses at files to remove.
extension.disclaimer: Kodi does not report the result of another add-on's cleaning command, so results show what was run, not a measured outcome.
extension.news: 1.0.0: first release. Supports Elementum, POV and TMDb Helper (image cache only).
